items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 60:1
items.html: The Malchut of Atik that clothes in Arich Anpin is only the illumination of his Malchut, for the Malchut of Atik in its essence is hidden in Radla, as in the words of the Rav, p. 618, Item 23. (Inner Light, p. 632, entry "And behold")
